title: 성내동애견미용학원, 첫 방문에서 실습실의 무엇을 볼까?

sources.https://evaw-pet-grooming.co.kr/branches: 천호점 위치·출구·교육과정 확인. 방문·참관과 실제 시설 운영은 확인 질문으로 구성.

overlap: 기존 천호점 취업 과정 글, 강남의 시연 동작·멈춤 관찰 글과 대조. 성내동 편은 배정 자리, 위그·실견의 공간과 이동, 도구 구분, 뒤쪽 자리 시야를 직접 봄·설명 들음·추가 확인으로 기록.
alts: 짙은 갈색 배경의 회갈색 강아지와 성내동애견미용학원 문구
검은 미끄럼 방지 상판이 놓인 높이 조절 실습대와 주변 통로
밝은 털의 위그 모형과 금속 빗, 닫힌 가위가 놓인 실습대
회색 도구 받침 위의 빗과 브러시, 옆에 접힌 파란 수건
옆자리에서 바라본 위그 모형과 금속 빗을 가리키는 손
prompts: Create one square 1:1 1024x1024 editorial website thumbnail for a Korean guide to inspecting a dog grooming classroom. Photorealistic, exceptional natural fur detail. Single calm adult Slovakian Rough-haired Pointer, distinguished shaggy silvery gray wire coat, floppy ears, cropped portrait of head and upper chest, large on the RIGHT half looking calmly toward camera, eyes fully visible. Rich dark warm clay-brown seamless studio wall; soft directional light, no room identifier. Set large bold clean cream Korean sans-serif at left center in just two left-aligned lines, precisely line 1 ‘성내동’ line 2 ‘애견미용학원’. Use the largest possible legible font and preserve left and right breathing space; no other glyphs. No person, logo, watermark, signs, badges, advertising decoration, or collage.

One 3:2 horizontal documentary editorial photograph for a student guide to inspecting dog grooming training rooms: an empty charcoal nonslip adjustable rectangular grooming table in a bright generic modern practice room in Korea, clean cream tile wall, side view with aisle around the table and powder blue cabinet, shelves gently out of focus. No dog, no people, no loop or tether, no words, no signage or logos, no watermark, photograph only. Realistic practical classroom scale. Daylight, soft shadows.

One 3:2 horizontal natural editorial photo of a dog grooming teaching station, side-angle: on a pale oak table a cream synthetic dog mannequin head (wig training model clearly artificial, a tidy uncut plush white training coat with muzzle and two ears, base stand visible), next to a narrow stainless comb and a CLOSED grooming scissor clearly lying flat on a pale gray nonslip mat. No dog, text, faces, labels, logo, watermark, or dramatic grading. Soft natural lighting, clear real materials. Focus on the training model and how the empty tabletop separates practice area and tools.

One 3:2 horizontal editorial documentary photo of a hygienic dog grooming classroom station. Close side view of a clean stainless-steel salon comb and pin brush separated on shallow pale gray tray, another empty tray behind, neatly folded slate blue towel to the right. Hair-free, no fake text, captions, hands or people, no bottles or chemicals, logo or watermark. Natural side window light. Realistic object proportions. Convey separating ready-to-use tools, no claim about any named facility.

One 3:2 horizontal calm editorial photograph looking from a visitor's position a few steps to the side of a grooming demonstration table, crop people above shoulders so no face is visible. One instructor’s forearm and natural hand show a stainless comb laid flat beside a white synthetic practice wig dog head, one student’s sleeve small and out of focus at frame edge. The teacher's hand and comb are easy to see from the side. Photorealistic, warm pale wall and dusty blue apron, generic studio teaching room, no live dog, no text logo or watermark, no dangerous action.
